channel.title: Anandhu P Shaji — Publications and Technical Essays
channel.description: Technical essays, research preprints, and open-source systems updates by Anandhu P Shaji.

item.title: Why Replay Isn't Enough: Fault-Tolerant State for Autonomous AI Agents
item.description: Architectural foundations for long-running AI agent reliability: semantic checkpoints, idempotent action ledgers, and hash-chained audit trails.

item.title: Positional Prüfer Sequences for Ordered Trees
item.description: A length-(n-1) bijective integer encoding for ordered rooted labeled trees with O(n) encoding and decoding, plus an O(1) query Navigation Index.

item.title: Hunting Compiler Bugs and Numerical Traps in TensorFlow: Inside Grappler, XLA, and Core Math
item.description: Inside 24 pull requests to TensorFlow: root-causing unsound algebraic rewrites in Grappler, shape lowering segfaults in XLA, and numerical gradient explosions in automatic differentiation.

item.title: Lightweight Medical Imaging: Lessons from HI-MobileNet
item.description: Transfer learning and efficient architectures for rare dermatological disease diagnosis on edge devices, achieving 99.96% accuracy.
